notes: Movements you can act on + a safer warehouse upload. Right-click a part on a truck (or hit 'Movements' on a tech) to jump to its full in/out history, and Print/export the Activity list for a paper trail. Uploading a warehouse CSV now shows a preview — new / changed / dropping-off counts — and warns hard (with an 'I understand' check) if the file has no quantity column or would drop a big chunk of the catalog.
